displayContract.byline: Assessments made by 5.6 Sol. — Rubric: Slugfester Reassessment Rubric v2.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that several independently motivated features of reality jointly support, without deductively compelling, a necessary and intelligent foundation resembling classical theism.

novelty.explanation: This replaces several categorical transitions with an explicitly cumulative and probabilistic thesis responsive to the identification objections.

premises.text: Essentially ordered dependence concerns what sustains derivative causal powers now, not an empirically inaccessible event before the universe, so temporal cosmological limits do not directly settle that metaphysical question.

novelty.explanation: This clarifies the First Way's intended non-temporal structure and directly answers the temporal-extrapolation criticism.

premises.text: If every concrete reality is contingent and receives existence derivatively, merely adding further contingent members does not explain why the dependent totality is actual rather than absent.

novelty.explanation: This develops the contingency claim into an explanatory argument without treating circularity as the only excluded alternative.

premises.text: A nonderivative foundation would require additional arguments for unity, immateriality, intellect, and agency before it could reasonably be identified with God; those attributes cannot be imported from the word cause.

novelty.explanation: This explicitly accepts and repairs the transcript's most important missing bridge from foundation to divine characteristics.

premises.text: Irreducible categorical reasons, if established, would favor an account grounded in rational value over one limited to instrumental facts, although secular moral realism remains a genuine competitor.

novelty.explanation: This narrows the moral claim and includes the strongest secular alternative rather than presupposing that objectivity must inhabit a mind.

premises.text: A hypothesis gains support only when it explains the combined data with greater unity, scope, and fewer independent assumptions than serious alternatives, not merely because another explanation is presently unknown.

novelty.explanation: This introduces explicit comparative criteria for a disciplined cumulative case rather than relying on explanatory gaps.

conclusion.text: If the dependency, contingency, rational-order, and categorical-value premises survive comparative scrutiny, classical theism becomes a serious cumulative explanation, though further attribute arguments and rival comparison remain necessary.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion preserves the natural-theology strategy while limiting its force to comparative support and acknowledging unfinished bridges.

newArguments.title: Bayesian convergence across domains
newArguments.text: Independent evidence can become jointly important even when no component is decisive. If sustaining dependence, contingent existence, intelligible regularity, consciousness, and categorical normativity are each somewhat more expected under purposive foundational reality than under available competitors, their likelihood contributions may converge. The case must state those comparative expectations, avoid counting correlated observations twice, and accept reduced force wherever a secular theory predicts the same data. This framework converts a list of assertions into a transparent cumulative comparison.

novelty.explanation: This adds a new probabilistic framework for combining evidence while guarding against dependence and double counting.

newArguments.title: Testing the personal-foundation bridge
newArguments.text: A foundation should be called personal only if additional features make agency or intellect explanatorily relevant. The theistic case could ask whether abstract necessity alone explains why reality is intelligible, value-laden, and capable of conscious rational inquiry, then compare that proposal with structural realism and brute necessity. Success would not follow from causation alone; it would require showing that a rational source unifies these features more economically and generates clearer expectations than impersonal alternatives.

novelty.explanation: This directly repairs the unsupported transition from an ordering foundation to intellect by specifying a comparative test.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that belief in God should remain withheld unless a defined divine hypothesis earns greater comparative support than natural, abstract, or presently unknown alternatives.

novelty.explanation: This unifies burden, revisability, and identification concerns into a proportionate comparative thesis.

premises.text: Withholding belief carries the burden of accurately assessing offered evidence, while categorical denial or metaphysical naturalism carries additional positive burdens not incurred by nonbelief alone.

novelty.explanation: This answers the strongest affirmative burden objection by distinguishing three epistemically different positions.

premises.text: The skeptical case should engage sustaining-dependence arguments on their own metaphysical terms rather than treating every First Way as a temporal hypothesis about conditions before the observable universe.

novelty.explanation: This corrects the temporal construal that weakened the original causal reply.

premises.text: Even a successful argument for some necessary or nonderivative foundation leaves open whether it is one, conscious, purposive, morally authoritative, or appropriately described as God.

novelty.explanation: This strengthens the identification objection while granting more of the metaphysical argument for analytical clarity.

premises.text: Novel explanatory candidates need not be demonstrated beforehand, but they must be sufficiently defined to yield comparative expectations, risk evidential failure, and outperform serious alternatives.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the overcategorical exclusion rule while preserving disciplined constraints on theological abduction.

premises.text: A secular moral theory can seek categorical authority in impartial reasons arising from agency, vulnerability, and reciprocal justification rather than relying only on objective means toward an adopted goal.

novelty.explanation: This introduces a new secular route intended to repair the unresolved foundation-selection problem in the well-being account.

conclusion.text: Because the presented routes leave important termination, identification, comparison, and normativity questions unresolved, revisable nonbelief remains warranted unless stronger discriminating evidence or argument closes those gaps.

novelty.explanation: This preserves the transcript's modest skeptical conclusion and identifies the specific conditions under which it should change.

newArguments.title: Explicit model-selection discipline
newArguments.text: Competing ultimate explanations should be assessed by clarity, scope, independent motivation, predictive or retrodictive discrimination, and resistance to ad hoc accommodation. Theism, structural necessity, brute fact, and acknowledged incompleteness should all face the same criteria. A hypothesis does not gain support merely by naming a cause, but neither is it excluded merely for being nonnatural. Where several models fit the same observations and no distinctive expectation is confirmed, suspension of judgment is the proportionate result.

novelty.explanation: This supplies a new neutral comparison framework that strengthens skepticism without excluding theological candidates by definition.

newArguments.title: Calibrating public and private evidence
newArguments.text: Religious experience may rationally affect the experiencer while carrying less interpersonal evidential weight when alternative psychological causes remain comparably expected. Public warrant should increase when reports are independently convergent, specific, prospectively risky, and resistant to ordinary error explanations. This approach neither dismisses interpersonal knowledge nor treats private conviction as publicly decisive. It answers the relational analogy by distinguishing first-person justification from evidence capable of establishing the disputed interlocutor for people who lack the experience.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the anecdotal revelation critique by offering graduated criteria for private justification and public evidential transfer.
